incident: Qwen3.6 Quark INT8 backend device lost after rejected local fused-kernel tests

observed_failure.request_context: external /v1/chat/completions request from 10.0.0.214 with prompt_token_ids_len=4138 and max_tokens=2048
observed_failure.primary_error: RuntimeError: level_zero backend failed with error: 20 (UR_RESULT_ERROR_DEVICE_LOST)

likely_cause: The incident followed several failed local XPU extension diagnostics that produced Level Zero aborts and a hung fused op. The accepted baseline itself had previously passed endpoint health checks; this is treated as contamination from the rejected experiment, not a promoted-recipe failure.

recovery.gpu_discovery: all four Intel Arc Pro B70 devices enumerated with xpu-smi discovery
recovery.action: relaunched the accepted TP4 32K PIECEWISE graph baseline in tmux with the same cache and environment
recovery.readiness: backend /v1/models ready on attempt 37; frontdoor /v1/models ready

lesson: Future unsafe XPU kernel diagnostics should not run on the same visible devices while the production-candidate endpoint is serving traffic. Use a stopped backend or a single isolated device with the frontdoor paused before testing extension binaries that can abort Level Zero.
